outcome: time to recovery from eclampsia (from severity features)
cohort: 608 eclamptic mothers admitted to East Gojjam zone Hospitals between January 2014 and December 2017.
finding: The median recovery time from eclampsia was 12 hours, with recovery rates significantly influenced by maternal age, duration of labor, number of convulsions, and whether eclampsia was antepartum or postpartum.
followup_time: until maternal recovery from eclampsia, with a median of 12 hours (inter-quartile range 1-48 hours).
